text:
maria: Heads-up — reproducible weirdness in sample-app fncall flow when auth retry fires: arguments get double-stringified.
alan: Can you paste the minimal repro/logs?
maria: Repro (python SDK) — when token refresh happens inside retry wrapper we end up sending function_call.arguments as a JSON string instead of an object:
```json
"function_call": {
  "name": "create_event",
  "arguments": "{\"title\":\"Lunch\",\"time\":\"12:30\"}"
}
```
Note the arguments value above is a string.
sam: Hmm — is this happening in JS SDK too or just Python? :thinking:
maria: Only seen in py so far. JS returns arguments as an object.
jen: Likely double-serialize in the retry middleware. Our json-mode helper runs in the request path and the retry wrapper might call the serializer again after rehydrating the request body.
alan: Sounds plausible. We had a similar layering bug in HTTP middleware before. Can you add a unit test that simulates a 401 and verifies the function_call payload type?
dev-bot: CI: sample-app/fncall unit tests failing (3 tests) — see run 2025-10-18T12:04:02Z
maria: Workaround for customers: patch their retry hook to avoid re-encoding if body is already a str/bytes, but that's fragile.
sam: I can take this. Plan: add an integration test that forces token refresh on first attempt, assert the outgoing body still has arguments as an object (not a string). Then ensure serializer is idempotent. Assigning to me.
jen: Also add a small e2e sample in the bootcamp repo so new users don't hit this on onboarding.
alan: And add an SDK parity test between JS and Py for fncall/jsonmode — assert types match.
maria: I opened a PR with the failing test + proposed fix (avoid double-dump by checking type before dumping): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 — includes notes and a regression test.
sam: Looking now. Quick thought: instead of type-checking in many places, maybe centralize serialization in the transport layer and make retry operate on a fully-serialized blob. That way we avoid subtle differences between SDKs.
jen: Agree. Also update docs in "structured output" guide about how function_call.arguments are represented in JSON mode vs raw mode.
alan: Don't forget to add a migration note for customers using their own retry middleware.
maria: Thanks y'all. I'll follow up in the PR with the test logs. If anyone sees this in JS, flag it, but so far it's Py-only. :eyes: :bug:
